title: Conrad Koh Samui Unveils ‘The Pearl’: An Elevated Sanctuary for Wellness, Privacy and Personalized Luxury
summary: Conrad Koh Samui unveiled 'The Pearl', a two‑level Presidential Villa and Conrad Koh Samui’s most exclusive accommodation.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **The Pearl is a 766 square-metre, two-level Presidential Villa and Conrad Koh Samui’s most exclusive accommodation.**
- **Set at the resort’s highest point, the villa features panoramic views of the Gulf of Thailand and the Five Islands, with expansive indoor and outdoor living spaces.**
- **Designed for private wellness and bespoke escapes, The Pearl includes a couple’s treatment suite, sauna and steam rooms, hot and cold hydrotherapy plunge pools, fitness space, a 20-metre infinity pool, private outdoor cinema and chef-led dining experiences.**


**KOH SAMUI, Thailand –**[Conrad Koh Samui](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/usmksci-conrad-koh-samui/) today unveiled[The Pearl](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/usmksci-conrad-koh-samui/the-pearl-villa/) **,** the resort's most exclusive accommodation: a 766-square-metre, two-level Presidential Villa designed for guests seeking privacy, wellbeing and deeply personalized service. Set at the resort’s highest point, The Pearl brings together expansive indoor and outdoor living, dedicated wellness facilities and bespoke dining experiences, all framed by sweeping views of the Gulf of Thailand and the Five Islands.


Across two levels, The Pearl unfolds through a series of spaces designed for entertaining, restoration and outdoor living.


**Upper Entertainment Level** : Guests arrive at an expansive terrace overlooking sweeping panoramas of the Five Islands, an ideal backdrop for sunset aperitifs. Designed for hosting and connection, the upper level also features an open-plan living room, private bar and dedicated catering kitchen for bespoke chef-led dining experiences.


**Lower Master Suite & Wellness Sanctuary** : The lower-level centers around a master suite framing uninterrupted sea vista, a walk-in wardrobe, a marble spa bathroom with a rain shower and deep-soaking private jacuzzi. Adjacent to the suite is a dedicated wellness enclave featuring a private couple's treatment suite, sauna and steam rooms, hot and cold hydrotherapy plunge pools, and a fully equipped fitness space.


**Outdoor Living:** Extending from the master suite, the outdoor terrace features a 20-metre infinity pool, sun loungers, a private outdoor cinema and a sunken dining pavilion overlooking the coastline.


Conrad Koh Samui - The Pearl Outdoor Deck


## A design language rooted in nature and Thai craft


Inspired by Koh Samui's dramatic landscape and Thailand's architectural traditions, The Pearl combines natural materials, artisanal craftsmanship and contemporary design. A sculptural feature wall influenced by traditional Thai timber construction serves as the villa's centerpiece, reimagining interwoven woodwork through a contemporary lens.


Throughout the villa, warm woods, natural stone and layered textures are complemented by abundant natural light, creating a seamless connection between the interiors, outdoor terraces and the surrounding island environment. Subtle references to the sea, sand and sky further reinforce the villa's connection to its setting, balancing a strong sense of place with refined residential luxury.


Conrad Koh Samui - The Pearl Bedroom


## Private Wellness Without Leaving the Villa


A defining feature of The Pearl is the integration of wellness facilities directly within the residence itself. Guests can move seamlessly between relaxation, movement and recovery without leaving the privacy of their villa, creating an experience tailored entirely to their own pace and preferences.


At the heart of the wellness offering is a dedicated hydrotherapy experience, centered around hot and cold plunge pools designed to complement relaxation and recovery rituals. Combined with the sauna and steam rooms, the space provides guests with the flexibility to create personalised wellness routines throughout their stay, whether beginning the day with an energising circuit or unwinding after an afternoon spent exploring the island.


Complementing the wellness facilities are bespoke dining experiences, dedicated guest services and expansive indoor and outdoor living spaces. From sunrise movement sessions and hydrotherapy rituals to sunset aperitifs overlooking the Five Islands and intimate chef-led dinners, every aspect of the experience has been designed to bring together wellbeing, privacy and personalised luxury within a single setting.


Conrad Koh Samui - The Pearl Master Bathroom


"With The Pearl, we are introducing a new way to experience Conrad Koh Samui, one that brings together privacy, wellbeing and a deeply personalized service," said Marco Araujo, general manager, Conrad Koh Samui. "Today's travelers increasingly value privacy, wellbeing, and the freedom to curate their own pace of travel. The Pearl brings all of these elements together within a single sanctuary where guests can reconnect, restore and indulge in complete seclusion while surrounded by the natural beauty of Koh Samui."


## Availability and bookings


The Pearl, Presidential Villa, will welcome its first guests from 1 October 2026.


For reservations or more information, please visit[conradkohsamui.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/usmksci-conrad-koh-samui/) or emailConrad_Koh_Samui@conradhotels.com .


##### FAQ: Conrad Koh Samui Unveils “The Pearl”: An Elevated Sanctuary for Wellness, Privacy and Personalized Luxury


The Pearl is a 766-square-metre, two-level Presidential Villa at Conrad Koh Samui. It is the resort’s most exclusive accommodation, designed as a private sanctuary for wellness, dining, entertainment and relaxation.


The Pearl is located at the highest point of Conrad Koh Samui, overlooking the Gulf of Thailand and the Five Islands.


The Pearl features a private wellness enclave with a couple’s treatment suite, sauna and steam rooms, hot and cold hydrotherapy plunge pools, and a fully equipped fitness space.


The Pearl includes an open-plan living room, private bar, dedicated catering kitchen, master suite with sea views, marble spa bathroom, 20-metre infinity pool, private outdoor cinema and sunken dining pavilion overlooking the coastline.


The Pearl Presidential Villa will welcome its first guests in October 2026. Guests can visit[conradkohsamui.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/usmksci-conrad-koh-samui/) or emailConrad_Koh_Samui@conradhotels.com for reservations and more information.

## About Conrad Koh Samui


A true tropical paradise awaits, a sanctuary of crafted luxury and conscious living where nature’s grandeur meets the art of refined seclusion. Perched on a secluded hillside overlooking the Gulf of Thailand, Conrad Koh Samui unfolds as a private cliffside retreat designed for reflection, rejuvenation, and reconnection. Surrounded by bold landscapes and the world’s most breathtaking sunsets, the resort’s 82 stand-alone pool villas offer unmatched privacy and panoramic ocean views. Each detail whispers a pursuit of perfection, a harmony of exclusivity woven into the essence of our own slice of heaven. Blending contemporary design with eco-conscious elegance, Conrad Koh Samui celebrates a seamless connection between luxury and sustainability. Guests are invited to reconnect through holistic wellness, yoga, and nature-inspired spa rituals, while locally sourced, farm-to-table dining highlights the island’s rich flavors and the produce of the resort’s own Iris Farm. Here, handcrafted hospitality ensures a stay that is nothing short of extraordinary, an experience of timeless tranquility, where every moment embodies the spirit of sustainable luxury crafted for conscious travelers.
